notable_absence.finding: No management-plane role gate, credential-type privilege table, or capella-role content appears anywhere on this page - it is pure query-optimizer syntax, consistent with round 2's finding that requiresCapellaRole/credential-type privileges are reserved for statement execution and data access, not optimizer hint syntax.

cross_product_finding: NO_USE_HASH is badged '[ENTERPRISE EDITION]' with a link directly to https://www.couchbase.com/products/editions - a genuine, deliberate cross-reference to server/'s Enterprise/Community edition split appearing on a Capella hint page, despite Capella itself having no discrete editions. Unlike the recurring 'cites-server-versions' anomaly (which is an apparent copy-paste artifact), this edition badge looks like an intentional authoring choice (the same badge style server/ uses for EE-only features), reused as-is on the Capella page even though the concept doesn't map cleanly onto Capella's access model.
